summary: On May 15, 2026, Rithm Perpetual Life Residential Trust filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) reporting its Net Asset Value (NAV) per share as of April 30, 2026. The filing discloses NAV per share of $20.1562 for Class J common shares and $20.2389 for Class E common shares, calculated per board-approved valuation guidelines. No transaction, strategic review, or corporate event is announced; it is a routine monthly NAV update typical for a closed-end fund or REIT. No deal terms, recommendations, or advisors are mentioned. This is not a special situation; it is an informational filing with no arbitrage angle.
